tooltip.iannvanillareenchanted.enchantme: Enables sword sweep attacks at 80% attack charge or higher while grounded, not sprinting and moving slowly. Critical hits normally prevent sweeping. Increases sweep damage at each level. Swords without Sweeping Edge do not sweep.

A successful thrown hit or a strike on a lightning rod summons lightning, even without a thunderstorm or open sky. Lightning creates no fire blocks and does not ignite entities. Has a 35-second lightning cooldown shared by your Channeling tridents; throwing remains available while it recharges.

Returns your thrown trident. If the throw successfully damages an enemy, retrieving it grants that trident 3 charges for 15 seconds. Each successful melee hit consumes one charge and deals 10%/20%/30% more damage at levels I/II/III. Another successful throw and retrieval refreshes the charges and timer. Misses do not grant or refresh charges. Does not increase Riptide damage.

Start charging only while on land or in water; a charge already started can be released in the air. Protected from hits and projectiles during the spin. Colliding with an enemy deals a fixed 12 damage before defenses, cannot critically hit, ends the dash and bounces you backward and upward. Has an 8-second trident cooldown that starts after the dash when you touch land or water and counts down twice as fast in water.
examplemod.configuration.title: Example Mod Configs
tooltip.iannvanillareenchanted.descripti: No description available. Enchantment Descriptions or a resource pack can provide one.
tooltip.iannvanillareenchanted.enchantme: Repairs damaged armor on armor stands and damaged items in item frames at 100% durability per 3 hours of game time. Progress counts in unloaded chunks, but not while the server is stopped.

Chestplates only. Grants a recharging shield that absorbs damage before golden hearts and health. Capacity: %s HP per level. Recharges %s HP per second after %s seconds without damage. Drowning, starvation, and void damage bypass the shield.
enchantment.iannvanillareenchanted.high_: Step up one-block obstacles while sprinting in enchanted leggings, or two-block obstacles while riding a horse wearing enchanted armor. Ridden horses can also step up while descending through the air and moving forward.
tooltip.iannvanillareenchanted.enchantme: Step up one-block obstacles while sprinting in enchanted leggings, or two-block obstacles while riding a horse wearing enchanted armor. Ridden horses can also step up while descending through the air and moving forward.
enchantment.iannvanillareenchanted.elusi: Protects your horse from cacti and berry bushes, including berry-bush slowdown, and lets it walk on powder snow. While mounted, pass through leaves and run on water for 3 seconds. Water running recharges on solid ground.
tooltip.iannvanillareenchanted.enchantme: Protects your horse from cacti and berry bushes, including berry-bush slowdown, and lets it walk on powder snow. While mounted, pass through leaves and run on water for 3 seconds. Water running recharges on solid ground.
enchantment.iannvanillareenchanted.momen: Preserves speed on short downhill drops while riding forward. Ride mostly straight for 2 seconds to gain 20% movement speed per level; allows up to 30 degrees of turning per second. Sharp turns or stopping end the speed bonus. Uses the stronger bonus of Momentum or Speed potions.
enchantment.iannvanillareenchanted.wind_: Hold attack to raise and charge the mace. Fully charges in 1.25 seconds, adding up to 2 blocks of effective fall distance per level to the released smash. Release to strike within normal reach. Move freely while charging. Has a 0.75-second cooldown when equipped and after release, even on a miss. A successful Wind Burst reduces post-hit recovery to 0.25 seconds.
tooltip.iannvanillareenchanted.enchantme: Falling attacks launch you approximately 6/8/10 blocks upward, including while sprinting. Requires falling through the air, a ready attack, and no climbing, water, blindness, or riding. With Wind Up, release while aiming at least 60 degrees down at reachable ground to burst without a target. A proc reduces attack recovery to 0.25 seconds. Recharges for 5 seconds after landing. Incompatible with Shockwave.
enchantment.iannvanillareenchanted.shock: While airborne and descending, mace smash hits instantly create a ground shockwave behind the struck enemy in a 60-degree cone reaching 6 blocks. Deals 25%/50%/75% of the smash hit damage before armor at levels I/II/III. Only grounded secondary targets are damaged, and each applies its own defenses. With Wind Up, release while aiming at least 60 degrees down at reachable ground to trigger the cone, while airborne and descending, with no minimum charge requirement. Longer charges increase damage. Ground slams use smash damage without a critical-hit multiplier. Incompatible with Wind Burst. Does not damage blocks.
enchantment.iannvanillareenchanted.echoi: Non-critical melee hits grant 1 charge per enemy damaged, including extra sweep targets, up to 3. Your next successful critical hit consumes all charges, dealing 10%/15%/20% more damage per charge at levels I/II/III. Charges expire after 15 seconds without melee damage from this sword. Found in Ancient City chests.
